Ravi N: FYI onboarding run for atlas-lite-32k-int8 showed a repeatable RoPE-phase drift at the 30k boundary when prefilling across 4 shards. attaching quick notes.
Maya L: can you paste the minimal repro flags?
Ravi N: used:
./tools/longctx_run --model atlas-lite-32k --quant int8-channel --ropescale rescale2 --prefill_stride 64 --shards 4 --capture-kv --kv-checksum 1024 --job atlas-20260320-a
Ravi N: log excerpt:
[2026-03-20T11:30:12Z] KV-CHECKSUM(tile=29)=0x3b2f11
[2026-03-20T11:30:12Z] KV-CHECKSUM_DEQUANT(tile=29)=0x3b2f11
[2026-03-20T11:30:12Z] KV-CHECKSUM(tile=30)=0x9c4a77
[2026-03-20T11:30:12Z] DIFF first-mismatch tile=30 offset=44 global-token=30044
[2026-03-20T11:30:12Z] INFER(INT8): token=30045 predicted="party"
[2026-03-20T11:30:12Z] INFER(FP16): token=30045 predicted="party."
Owen T: similar to past cases but note this is reproducible even with `kv-align=true`. did you try `quant-scale-mode global`?
Ravi N: quick test: global scale + `rotary_interpolate=true` -> checksum diffs drop to 0/32 tiles. perf hit ~3%.
Maya L: good signal. create a small canary that runs global-scale in dedicated to validate tail latency before enabling on hosted.
ci-bot: artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/atlas-20260320-a/logs.tar.gz
Ravi N: opened ML ticket ML-9401, will add a 30k-boundary regression to onboarding checklist and record perf delta. closing thread unless more repros.
